g.title: legacy
g.text: Java Pet Store 1.3.1_02 — LEGACY Components & Their Roles
J2EE 1.3 BluePrints · 4 deployable EARs · WAF web controller · 19 reusable components · EJB 2.x CMP · JMS · Cloudscape

g.title: mainservlet
g.text: Front controller. Single entry for every *.do /\l*.screen request; dispatches to the flow.

g.title: reqproc
g.text: Turns an HTTP request into a WAF Event and\linvokes the matching HTMLAction.

g.title: webctl
g.text: Session façade: routes Events to server-side\lEJBActions (business logic).

g.title: ordereaction
g.text: CHECKOUT: builds a PurchaseOrder from the cart,\lgets an id (uidgen), publishes it to JMS. No persist.

g.title: screenflow
g.text: Decides the next screen after an action\l(screen-flow / navigation rules).

g.title: statemachine
g.text: Holds per-session state; maps Events → EJBActions.

g.title: shopfacade
g.text: Per-session façade holding the user's cart +\lidentity for the web tier.

g.title: templates
g.text: 98 locale-aware JSPs render the views;\lHTMLActions bind form data.

g.title: pomdb
g.text: Consumes the PO off the queue → PERSISTS the\lorder, starts the approval workflow.

g.title: customer
g.text: Customer aggregate: contact, address, profile\lprefs, credit card (CMP entities).

g.title: cart
g.text: Stateful session cart (itemId→qty map). Lives in\lthe HttpSession; 15-min session timeout.

g.title: po
g.text: PurchaseOrder + LineItem CMP entities +\lXML (toXML) for the JMS message.

g.title: supplierpo
g.text: Supplier-PO doc; UniqueIdGenerator EJB\l(persistent order-id counter from 1001).

g.title: async
g.text: AsyncSender puts the PO (as XML) on the queue;\lProcessManager tracks order workflow status.

g.title: catalogaction
g.text: Browse, add-to-cart, register, sign-on request\lhandlers (call the reusable components).

g.title: suporder
g.text: Consumes approved orders → fulfils from inventory,\lships, sends invoice back to OPC.

g.title: catalog
g.text: Read catalog (category/product/item), locale-split,\lvia hand-written DAO SQL.

g.title: signon
g.text: Authenticate + create users; protects URLs via\lsignon-config (checkout requires login).

g.title: cloudscape
g.text: Relational store: CMP-generated tables +\lhand-written catalog schema.

g.title: approvalmdb
g.text: Approves/denies (auto under threshold), advances\lthe order state; triggers mails + supplier PO.

g.title: invoicemdb
g.text: Consumes supplier invoices → marks the order\lshipped/COMPLETED.

g.title: adminclient
g.text: Owns NO data. Lists orders by status and\lsubmits approve/deny by calling OPCAdminFacade.

g.title: opcfacade
g.text: Admin queries: orders-by-status, order detail\l(called by admin.ear).

g.title: mailmdbs
g.text: Customer-relations: build order emails and hand\lthem to the mailer.

g.title: mailer
g.text: Sends email via JavaMail when a Mail message\larrives on MailQueue.

g.title: rcvr
g.text: The 'receiver' web UI: view stock + restock\l(qty_<item> params → InventoryEJB.setQuantity).

g.title: xmldocs
g.text: TPA XML (invoice/PO) marshalling; JNDI lookup\lcache; shared utilities + encoding filter.

g.title: jms
g.text: Async backbone between the 4 EARs:\lPurchaseOrder/Approval/Mail queues + InvoiceTopic.

g.title: j2eeri
g.text: App server hosting EJB 2.x, servlets/JSP,\lJMS, JNDI.
